name: StartExecution

parameters.help_en: The name of the template. The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The name can be up to 200 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称。内容限制为字母、数字、中划线、下划线，长度200字符
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en: The version number of the template. If you do not specify this parameter, the latest version is used
parameters.help_zh: 版本号，如不填默认为最新的版本号
parameters.name: template_version

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode. Valid values:

Automatic (default): The execution is automatically run.

FailurePause: The execution is paused if a task fails.

Debug: The execution is run in single-step mode
parameters.help_zh:
执行模式。取值：
Automatic（默认值）：自动执行
FailurePause：失败暂停
Debug：单步执行
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The loop mode. Valid values:

Automatic (default): The execution is not paused.

FirstBatchPause: The execution is paused after the first batch of tasks is completed.

EveryBatchPause: The execution is paused after each batch of tasks is completed
parameters.help_zh:
循环模式。取值：
Automatic（默认值）：不暂停
FirstBatchPause：第一批暂停
EveryBatchPause：每批暂停
parameters.name: loop_mode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent execution
parameters.name: parent_execution_id

parameters.help_en:
The security check mode. Valid values:

Skip (default): This option indicates that you are aware of the risks. The system performs all actions without asking for confirmation, regardless of the risk level. This mode is valid only when Mode is set to `Automatic`.

ConfirmEveryHighRiskAction: This option requires you to confirm every high-risk action. You can call the NotifyExecution operation to confirm or cancel an action
parameters.help_zh:
安全检查模式。取值：

Skip（默认值）：此选项表示客户了解风险，无需确认即可执行任何Action，无论什么风险等级。`Mode=Automatic`时有效。
ConfirmEveryHighRiskAction：此选项会要求客户确认每一个高风险的Action。客户通过调用NotifyExecution接口进行确认或取消
parameters.name: safety_check

parameters.help_en: The JSON string that consists of a collection of parameters. The default value is {}
parameters.help_zh: 由参数集合组成的Json字符串，默认为{}
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotency of the request
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The tags to add to the execution
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_zh: 要给执行添加的描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.example: {   "Description": "Example template, describe instances in some status",   "FormatVersion": "OOS-2019-06-01",   "Parameters": {},   "Tasks": [     {       "Name": "describeInstances",       "Action": "ACS::ExecuteAPI",       "Description": "desc-en",       "Properties": {         "Service": "ECS",         "API": "DescribeInstances",         "Parameters": {           "Status": "Running"         }       }     }   ] }
parameters.help_en: The content of the template, which must be in the JSON or YAML format. This parameter is the same as the Content request parameter of the CreateTemplate operation. You can specify this parameter to run the tasks in the template content without the need to create a template. You do not need to specify this parameter if you use an existing template to create an execution
parameters.help_zh: 模板内容，JSON或YAML格式（同CreateTemplate API 请求参数中的Content字段）。用户传入此字段可直接执行TemplateContent中的任务，而无需提前创建模板再创建执行任务（当用户选择已有的Template创建执行任务时不需传入此字段）
parameters.name: template_content

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The URL of the Object Storage Service (OSS) object that stores the OOS template content. The URL must be a public-read URL. You can specify this parameter to run the tasks in the template content that is stored in the OSS object without the need to create a template. You do not need to specify this parameter if you use an existing template to create an execution
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云对象存储OSS中存放OOS模板内容的URL(只支持公共读的URL)。用户传入此字段可直接根据行TemplateURL中存储的模板内容创建执行任务，无需提前创建模板再创建执行任务（当用户选择已有的Template创建执行任务时不需传入此字段）
parameters.name: template_url
